W0.summary: 2015 addition, Ring Road face: red-brown brick; four tall two-storey windows with pale frames, a long green-glass clerestory ribbon above the northern three, high brick parapet; the south ~9 m is lower (~14 m) with the white metal box rising behind
attached: the clerestory runs s 0.6-18.5 only (over the first three tall windows); over the fourth window (s 19.8-24.6) the wall is plain brick
at s ~20-29 the brick parapet steps down to ~13.8 m; the white metal-clad box (19.5-21 m) stands set back behind it (earth_W0_whole, earth_corner_1)
W0.notes: Measured on earth_W0_whole (Earth 2024, ~41 px/m): windows s 1.0-6.1, 7.3-12.2, 13.6-18.4, 19.8-24.6, z ~1.8-8.4; clerestory z ~9.8-12.4; parapet 17.2. Window detail from sv_c2 (May 2025, the only recent SV): dark green-grey glass, many horizontal transoms, dark mullions, pale precast/metal surround. All other SV of this wall is Sep 2014 construction. a = north end.

W1.summary: full-height glass stair/atrium tower at the SW corner of the 2015 addition: dark-framed curtain wall, pale grey spandrel band at each floor
W1.notes: sv_c2 (2025): 3 lites across, two lites per floor plus an opaque light grey glass spandrel at each slab; glass reads green-grey (#627376 overcast). Wraps onto the west end of W2 (s 0-3). Height from the lidar lavender tier (19.5), not seen to the top.

W2.summary: south face of the 2015 addition over the main entrance: plain red-brown brick to ~13.6 m with the white metal box nearly flush above to 19.5; the glass tower wraps its west end; the low glazed entrance vestibule stands in front at grade
attached: glazed entrance vestibule in front at grade: lidar 4.5 m strip x 883-900, y 100-106; dark-framed glass walls, a glass-and-steel canopy (prop_lamp frame) projecting ~2.5 m west toward Ring Road at ~3.6 m; glass double doors on its west face (sv_c2)
W2.notes: From earth_W2_whole and earth_corner_5 (2024): no windows seen in the brick between the glass tower and the east end. 2014 SV shows only scaffolding. White box flush or nearly flush above (lidar lavender reaches this line).

W3.summary: 1971 wing's north end facing the entrance plaza: buff brick, one bay of the recessed-level-2 type between plain ends

l2/A.note: deep recessed window: dark sloped metal sill z 3.7-4.35, glass 4.35-5.7, dark soffit/shadow 5.7-6.7 (sv_c12, sv_c11)

W3.notes: sv_W3 / sv_c5 (Sep 2014, construction) show the recessed level-2 window and ribbons on this end; in 2025 (sv_c2) it sits behind the entrance vestibule and link, mostly hidden.

W4.summary: 1971 Ring Road face, north part: buff-brown brick with narrow projecting piers; per bay a flush ribbon window on the ground floor, a deep-recessed level-2 window over a dark sloped sill, and a flush ribbon at level 3 under a 2.3 m solid brick fascia

l2/A.note: deep recessed window: dark sloped metal sill z 3.7-4.35, glass 4.35-5.7, dark soffit/shadow 5.7-6.7 (sv_c12, sv_c11)

W4.notes: Bay type from sv_W4_*, the left side of sv_c6 and sv_W5_CiRox_100; earth_W4_whole is blurred by a tree, so 4 bays of ~6 m is a best fit, not a count. Ground drops toward Ring Road: the ground floor is partly below the planted berm (sv_W4_Q5Sw). This face sits 3.8 m behind W5's line. a = north end.

W5.summary: 1971 Ring Road face, south part: the old main entrance at the north end, a two-storey deep brick portal (brick column on its north side, white soffit with downlights) reached by wide concrete steps with galvanised railings; south of it three bays of flush ribbon windows on all three floors between piers

l2/portal.note: open recess continuing up to a white soffit at ~z 7.6

W5.notes: sv_W5_CiRox_100 / sv_c6 (Sep 2014): portal at s ~1.5-7, about 8 risers up from the Ring Road sidewalk; a passenger loading zone sign. sv_W5_WDV: flush ribbons (about 7 panes per bay) on all floors, no level-2 recess on this stretch. Pier positions differ by ~1 m between the two panos. a = north end.

W6.summary: 1971 long south face over the lawn: buff-brown brick, seven 5.9 m bays between narrow projecting piers, each with a flush ground ribbon, a deep-recessed level-2 window over a dark sloped metal sill, a flush level-3 ribbon, and a continuous 2.3 m brick fascia; plain end bays

l2/A.note: deep recessed window: dark sloped metal sill z 3.7-4.35, glass 4.35-5.7, dark soffit/shadow 5.7-6.7 (sv_c12, sv_c11)

W6.notes: Bays counted on earth_W6_whole (27.5 px/m) and earth_corner_10/12; detail from sv_c11 (west end) and sv_c12 (east end), Sep 2014 sunlit. East end bay: flush windows at levels 1 and 3, plain brick at level 2. West end: ground window only. The recessed glass looks pale (white blinds). a = west end.

W7.summary: 1971 east end facing the east plaza: buff brick, three bays (narrow, wide, narrow) between a single and a doubled pier, flush ribbon windows on all three floors, a solid grey steel door in the wide bay at grade
W7.notes: sv_W7_100 (Sep 2014) square-on. Door solid grey (#7c766d) at the south end of the wide bay with ribbons beside it. a = south end.

W8.summary: recessed bay between the east end and the stair tower: at grade a pair of grey steel doors under a dark louvre; above, the raised terrace with tube railing and a glazed door; top floor a ribbon under a white soffit
attached: the east terrace (z ~3.7) runs in front: concrete deck with galvanised tube railing; its podium walls are clad in horizontal cedar-coloured wood slats (#d9925b) (sv_c12, sv_c14, sv_W7_100)

W9.summary: east stair tower (taller than the wing, ~15 m) in buff brick with a full-height dark vertical louvre slot; the big outdoor stair (yellow nosings) climbs past it to the east terrace
W9.notes: sv_c15, sv_c16, sv_c19 (Sep 2014). Tower width and height are guesses (lidar 13.5-15 here). The podium part is the stair/terrace wall in wood slats.

W10.summary: back of the east tower and terrace toward the north service court: buff brick, mostly plain, one short level-3 ribbon
W10.notes: Trees hide it from SV (sv_W10, Sep 2014); earth_corner_17/19 show a mainly blank brick face with a few windows. Guess.

W11.summary: 1971 north face toward the service court and parking: buff brick, five bays of flush ribbon windows on all three floors between piers
W11.notes: earth_W11_whole, earth_corner_25 (2024): piers and flush ribbons on the upper floors; ground floor hidden. No recessed level 2 seen here (unlike W4/W6). Bay count approximate; the level-1 ribbons are a guess.

W12.summary: 2015 glazed link between the 1971 wing and the addition: dark green-grey curtain wall with lighter teal panes in vertical strips, slab bands every floor
W12.notes: Earth only (earth_corner_14/16/17, earth_W12/W13_whole, 2024): dark glass #688474 with a column of brighter teal panes (duct_teal) near the corner. No Street View (court side).

W13.summary: 2015 glazed link between the 1971 wing and the addition: dark green-grey curtain wall with lighter teal panes in vertical strips, slab bands every floor
W13.notes: Earth only (earth_corner_14/16/17, earth_W12/W13_whole, 2024): dark glass #688474 with a column of brighter teal panes (duct_teal) near the corner. No Street View (court side).

W14.summary: short south face of the addition's east block above the link roof: red-brown brick with a green-glass ribbon window on the top floor
W14.notes: Seen only over the 1971 roof in earth_W6_m / earth_corner_14 (2024); the lower floors are hidden by the link, so l1/l2 are left plain.

W15.summary: east face of the addition toward the service court: red-brown brick, long green-glass ribbon windows (7-8 dark-framed panes) on floors 2 and 3, white metal box set back above the south ~17 m, bridge leaving northward behind the north end

l1/rib.note: GUESS: hidden by trees in every view

W15.notes: earth_W15_whole (2024, ~44 px/m): ribbons s 3.7-22.7, one storey (3.75 m) apart, the top one ~2.6 m below the parapet. White box (top 21 m) set back ~1 m behind the parapet over s ~1-17. sv_W15_* (Sep 2014) show only construction. a = south end.

W16.summary: north face of the addition: lower east block (13.6 m) with the enclosed bridge leaving northward at s ~6-12; the west 20 m is the tall (17.2 m) brick block with three tall pale-framed windows and the green clerestory ribbon, same design as W0

tall/rib.note: GUESS: W15's ribbons assumed to continue round the corner

attached: enclosed bridge north from s ~6.4-11.5 (lidar strip x 905-910) at about z 9-13: pale grey/white metal cladding with a continuous glazed band (earth_W15_whole, earth_corner_26); its destination to the north is not verified from these photos
W16.notes: Only earth_corner_26 shows this face (3 tall windows + clerestory on the west part, matching W0); earth_W16_whole is a roof view; both SV for W16 are black (indoor). a = east end.

geometry_notes: The glazed entrance vestibule (lidar 4.5 m, x 883-900, y 100-106) in front of W2 is not in walls.json; model it as a glass box with a canopy facing Ring Road.
The white box should be its own volume, set back ~1 m behind W15 and behind W0's south part, nearly flush over W2; walls.json follows the brick faces.
W0 has two heights: the north ~20 m of the face is the 17.2 m block, the south ~9 m steps down to ~13.8 m with the white box behind.
The W4/W5 junction is a 3.8 m step (W4 set back); the short connecting wall carries the portal's brick column.
The east stair tower (W9) rises to ~15 m, above the 12.3 m wing; the external stair and terrace podium (z ~3.7) on W8/W9/W10 are not in the massing.
